summary: Tested full backend pipeline (auth/register/login/me, projects CRUD, SRS gen via LLM, backlog approve/edit, developers CRUD, plan, replan, evaluation, ground-truth PATCH) and full UI flow (login, project create, all sidebar tabs, approve-all, add developer dialog, generate plan, sprint board move-fwd, replanning simulate developer_unavailable, analytics ground-truth recompute). Backend logic is fully functional end-to-end; UI flows all work. One CRITICAL infrastructure issue: Cloudflare edge times out /api/.../srs/text at ~60s while the Claude Sonnet 4.6 LLM call takes ~90-110s. User gets 502 in the UI even though backend eventually persists the requirements+backlog. This will make SRS generation feel broken to users via the preview URL.

critical.issue: Claude Sonnet 4.6 LLM synchronous call takes 90-110s but Cloudflare/CDN edge in the preview environment enforces a 60s idle timeout, returning HTML 502 to the client. Backend actually finishes and persists data ~30-60s AFTER the 502 is returned. Confirmed by curl: public URL returned 502 in 60.3s while data (15 requirements, 50 backlog items) still appeared in the DB. Recommend: (1) make SRS ingestion a background job with a jobs/{id} polling endpoint, or (2) return an id immediately and stream progress via SSE/WebSocket, or (3) chunk the LLM prompt / use a faster model.

minor.issue: Requires Authorization (Depends get_current_user); a 401 user calling logout gets 401 instead of an idempotent 200 - minor UX quirk.
If developer_id is null the code silently no-ops (`d['id'] != None` matches all) and still returns success. Should validate required params per event.

ui_bugs.issue: Generate backlog shows no visible progress; after ~60s the request fails at CDN (502) with no user-facing retry/poll. User perception: 'AI processing failed'. Data may quietly appear on Requirements/Backlog after another minute.
Clicking 'Approve all' when everything is already approved shows toast '0 items approved' which is misleading; should show 'Nothing to approve' or similar.
React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Accessibility warning only.

integration_issues.issue: Long LLM call breaks at 60s CDN timeout; frontend does not handle the 502 gracefully nor recover the eventually-persisted data. User must refresh and go to Backlog manually.

issues: Select developer dropdown is optional but has no validation; Simulate replanning succeeds with no dev picked and shows Before/After anyway.

action_items: CRITICAL: Move SRS/LLM processing to a background task and return a job id the frontend can poll; today the 60s CDN timeout makes SRS generation appear to fail even though the backend succeeds.

Frontend: on SRS submission, either poll GET /projects/{pid}/requirements or show 'This can take up to ~2 minutes; you will be notified when done' and fetch data on completion; do not surface the CF 502 HTML as a failure.
Backend: validate replan event parameters (developer_id required for developer_unavailable, item_id required for task_delay/task_blocked).
Minor: replace 'X items approved' toast with a friendlier no-op message when count is 0.
Accessibility: add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to shadcn DialogContent instances (New project, Add developer).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-site cookies but requires HTTPS in every deploy env.
routes.py delete_project deletes across collections in a loop - not transactional; ok for MVP but note if scale matters.
planner.build_plan is invoked twice per replan call (before + after) which is fine perf-wise. Overload rate metric is included as required.
srs_llm.generate_backlog blocks the request thread for ~100s; wrap in a task queue.
routes.py:485 `gt = project.get('ground_truth_count') or extracted` - if user sets ground_truth_count=0 this falls back to extracted rather than using 0. Consider explicit None check.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all UI flows tested; SRS gen is blocked by CDN timeout not UI code

seed_data_creation: Created two test projects during testing via localhost:8001 (UITEST_Seeded and UITEST_NewProj), used them for UI flows, and deleted both at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloudflare edge timeout is 60s in this preview environment; any endpoint that runs a synchronous Claude Sonnet 4.6 call (SRS ingestion) will return 502 to the client while backend completes ~30-60s later. When testing SRS ingestion from public URL, either (a) hit localhost:8001 directly, or (b) wait 60-90s after the 502 and re-query /requirements + /backlog to verify data landed. All other endpoints (< 3s) work over the public URL. Use the localhost seed pattern in /app/tests/test_sprintai.py for full pipeline. Frontend testIds are all reliable; no selector work needed.
rca of the issue: RCA (SRS 502): 1) User clicks Generate backlog -> POST /api/projects/{pid}/srs/text 2) Backend calls Claude Sonnet 4.6 via emergentintegrations synchronously in the request handler (srs_llm.generate_backlog) 3) LLM completion takes 90-110s for the sample SRS 4) Cloudflare/edge proxy in the *emergentagent.com preview closes the upstream after ~60s idle and returns 502 HTML to the browser 5) Backend still writes requirements + backlog docs to Mongo when the LLM finally returns. Repro: `time curl POST https://capacity-planner-47.preview.emergentagent.com/api/projects/{pid}/srs/text -d '{"text":"..."}'` returns HTTP 502 in ~60s while `curl localhost:8001/...` returns 200 with `{requirements:N,...}` in ~100s. Mitigation: convert LLM ingestion into an async job (return 202 + job_id, poll GET /jobs/{id}) or return the requirements+backlog id immediately and stream via SSE/websocket. As a stopgap, the frontend can start a 90s polling loop against /projects/{pid}/requirements + /backlog after firing the POST and hide the 502.
